caption: Ngwa Nforbi v. Hertz Global Holdings, Inc.
claims: None asserted. Prospective employment-screening monitoring only.
status: October 22, 2026: Manager Trainee offer from The Hertz Corporation accepted through Hertz Careers. The written offer is contingent on MVR (if applicable), criminal, employment, and education background checks. No screening report, offer rescission, or adverse action documented.
defendants: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. (requested matter caption); The Hertz Corporation (actual offer issuer / employment entity). Entity roles and any proper defendant require confirmation if a dispute arises.
note: Monitoring workspace only, not a filed case or a present accusation. ADP Work Opportunity Tax Credit screening is not evidence of a criminal background report. Preserve both entity names: Hertz Global Holdings, Inc. appears on the ADP request; The Hertz Corporation appears on the offer letter.
key_facts: October 2026: Kathleen HERTZ communicated by iMessage about an interview at Hertz Ridder Park, 725 Ridder Park Dr., San Jose, CA 95131. Invitation states 'Thursday 10/21 at 1pm,' an inconsistent weekday/date combination (Oct. 21, 2026 was Wednesday; Oct. 22 was Thursday). On Oct. 22 at 1:03 p.m. the applicant texted that rain/traffic delayed arrival. On Oct. 22 at 3:40 p.m., Kathleen texted to expect a Manager Trainee offer for Palo Alto. Gloria Williams of Hertz Talent Acquisition separately emailed at 3:38 p.m. confirming the team's intent to offer. Hertz Careers issued the formal offer at 3:39 p.m.; written offer dated Oct. 22 identifies The Hertz Corporation, full-time Manager Trainee, 816 San Antonio Rd., Palo Alto, CA 94303, reporting to Kathleen Williams, $23.00 per hour. Applicant emailed acceptance at 4:49 p.m. and Hertz Careers confirmed portal acceptance at 5:00 p.m. The application shows 'Offer Accepted' (job requisition 43711). ADP separately requested a WOTC questionnaire and supplied a completion confirmation. Hertz Careers requested additional application information at 5:00 p.m.; completion status of that separate request is not documented.
procedural_status: Pre-filing evidence-preservation and onboarding-monitoring matter. No complaint, docket number, court, opposing counsel, background report, preliminary adverse-action notice, or rescission documented. The operative hiring letter conditions employment on background checks; no violation is assumed.
